questions.question: Pressure is calculated as:
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Pressure: The force per unit area is called pressure. It is denoted by P.

 
 
• The SI unit of pressure is the pascal (Pa).
 
 

Pressure (P) = Force (F)/Area (A)

 
• Mass/Area: The areal density of a two-dimensional object is calculated as the mass per unit area. 

 
 
• The SI unit of area density is kg m−2.
 
 

EXPLANATION__:

From the above explanation, we can see that

Pressure = Force/ Area

i.e., The force exerted per unit area is called Pressure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The S.I unit of Pressure is Pascal, denoted by Pa.
 
• 1 bar = 1,00,000 pascal.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT true about Advocate General?

options.text: Advocate General is appointed by President of India
Each state has an Advocate General
Advocate General is appointed by Governor of the respective state
Advocate General’s function is similar to those of Attorney General

questions.solution:
__
 
• Article 165 deals with the Advocate General.
 
• The** Governor of a state appoints the Advocate General **__and it is his duty to give advice to the Government of the State upon such legal matters, and to perform such other duties of a legal character, as may from time to time be referred or assigned to him by the Governor.
 
• The Advocate-General holds the office during the pleasure of the Governor and receives remuneration as the Governor may determine.
 
• Only a person who is qualified to be a Judge of the High Court can be appointed as the Advocate-General for the State.

__**Note: Attorney General is for the centre and not state, he is appointed by the President.**__

questions.question: Natural or artificial bodies that revolve around a planet under its gravitational force of attraction are called:
questions.solution:
__

• Meteors are pieces of debris or dust from the space that burn up in the atmosphere of the earth.
 
• A star is a massive celestial body of gas which is self-luminous.

questions.question: Under MPLAD scheme each MP has the choice to suggest to the District Collector for works to the tune of Rs. _________ per annum to be taken up in his/her constituency.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Member of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS) was launched in the year 1993.
 
• Initially, every MP was given a fund of 5 lakh but in the year 2011, **it was increased to 5 Crore.**__
 
• In may 2014, Under the guidelines issued by the Ministry of Statistics and programme implementation, a member of parliament can use his fund outside his constituency.
 
• under those guidelines, One MP-One Idea, an annual competition in which ideas which can be used to solve local problems using funds from Member of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme(MPLADS) are rewarded.

questions.question: The National Press day is celebrated every year on __________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• National Press Day is observed on **16 November**__ every year.
 
• On this day, Press Council of India (PCI) started functioning as a __**moral watchdog**__.
 
• The PCI was first set up in the year 1966 by the Parliament on the recommendations of the 'First Press Commission'.
 
• The PCI has been mandated by Parliament to improve the standards of journalism and maintain its freedom.

questions.question: India, Afghanistan and which other country held their first trilateral meeting on Chabahar port project in October 2018?
questions.solution:
